gaps.lead: Living in the city is new to her.
gaps.sentence: She is not ___ in the city.
gaps.explanation: 'Be used to living' = be accustomed to (note the gerund).

gaps.lead: He can't be in Spain — I saw him here this morning.
gaps.sentence: He ___ in Spain — I saw him this morning.
gaps.explanation: can't/cannot possibly be = it is impossible that he is.

gaps.lead: 'Did you send the invoice?' the manager asked her.
gaps.explanation: if/whether + subject + backshifted verb: whether she had sent.

gaps.lead: She was made to wait for two hours.
gaps.explanation: 'Was made to wait' has the same meaning as 'had to wait'.

gaps.lead: He couldn't swim until he was twenty.
gaps.sentence: He ___ swim until he was twenty.
gaps.explanation: couldn't = was not able to (general ability in the past).

gaps.lead: The doctor said that he should take a complete rest.
gaps.sentence: The doctor advised ___ a complete rest.
gaps.explanation: say + should → advise + object + to-infinitive: advised him to take.
